theorems.name: Submission.cbrr_lipschitz_cover_of_cone_condition
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (D : Set (Euclid P)) (C : ℝ), Module.finrank ℝ T = n → (∀ x ∈ D, ∀ y ∈ D, ‖y - x‖ ≤ C * ‖T.starProjection (y - x)‖) → ∃ F : Euclid n → Euclid P, (∃ K : NNReal, LipschitzWith K F) ∧ D ⊆ range F
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
